title: AgentDeck (Composio-style dashboard)
tagline: An admin dashboard where a developer connects tools (GitHub, Slack, ...) to AI agents: 10 screens, light and dark, then a small SQLite mock server.

steps.title: At a glance
steps.goal: Decide in two minutes: **is this the dashboard I want built?** Nothing is built yet.

blocks.md: Ten screens with a left menu: **set up** apps (Toolkits, Auth Configs, Connected Accounts), **use** them (Triggers, Playground, Logs), and **manage** (Settings, API Keys, Docs). Light and dark theme, working buttons. First it runs on **fake data**; then a small mock server with a SQLite file keeps what you create after a restart; then Playground runs are really stored and shown in Logs.

items.v: You and your team, to review the screens **before** building
AgentDeck: original copy, no Composio logo or text (D-01)
Only the login page of the real dashboard was captured, so **every screen is invented** in its style and marked so
Two open questions: how to fill the screens, and which animations (step 6)

steps.title: A typical walk-through
steps.goal: Follow **one user journey** across the screens. Click a step to see what happens.

steps.title: Home
steps.text: 4 stats and a 3-step quickstart with a code sample. Numbers count up once; bars grow.
steps.see: Stats, tab "30 days" changes the bars; "Connect" in step 2 jumps to Connected Accounts.

steps.title: Create an auth config
steps.text: Auth Configs lists how sign-in works per app; **create** opens a form that validates.
steps.see: A new row; a field error if the form is wrong.

steps.title: Connect an account
steps.text: Connected Accounts: connect in 2 steps (drawer slides in from the right), reconnect when expired.
steps.see: A new account row with status Active.

steps.title: Playground → Run
steps.text: Pick a toolkit and action, edit the JSON, press **Run**.
steps.see: A fake response, and a new row is added to the shared list of runs.

steps.title: Logs
steps.text: Every run, newest first; search, filter (status, toolkit), open a row for detail, export.
steps.see: The run you just made is the top row.

steps.title: Decisions and quality
steps.goal: Two open questions. Each has a default, so silence means the default.

items.default: (a) we invent them from typical agent platforms
items.ifNo: (b) you log in once in the connected browser and we capture the real dashboard, or (c) you drop screenshots in `ref_notes/`

items.q: Animations: keep the small invented set or send the real ones?
items.ifNo: real motion replaces it if you supply a logged-in capture

items.default: AgentDeck, original copy, no Composio logo or text

items.q: Where mock data lives in phase 1
items.default: inside each screen file; only the list of runs is shared

items.q: A screens file holds how many screens?
items.default: split further if a file passes 600 lines
Bun + `bun:sqlite`, one file `agentdeck.sqlite`, no auth, seeded from the data model

blocks.title: Quality bar
items: Every list has search or filter, an empty state and a row that opens a detail view; every button acts (no "TODO", no "coming soon")
Forms validate and show a field error
Light and dark both pass text contrast 4.5:1
Works at 390 px (menu becomes a drawer); no horizontal scroll
0 console errors on every route; no file owned by two builders
Honest labels: invented screens are marked invented

steps.title: Phase 2 · Mock backend (SQLite)
steps.goal: **Create something, restart the server, reload: it is still there.**

blocks.title: Done when
items: create an auth config, restart the server, reload: it is still there
delete the SQLite file and restart: the seed data comes back
all screens still work (no console errors)

items.what: SQLite schema + seed from the data model (6 tables)
Mock server routes: list/create/update/delete for toolkits, auth configs, accounts, triggers, keys
Screens read and write through the server instead of in-file data

steps.title: Phase 3 · Live Playground and Logs
steps.goal: **Run in Playground and see a real stored row at the top of Logs, even after a restart.**

blocks.title: Done when
items: Run in Playground: a new row is on top of Logs
restart the server: the row is still there
filter status = Failed and export CSV match what is shown

items.what: `POST /run`: mock a tool call, store an execution row (tool, account, status, ms, request, response)
Logs reads executions with search, status, toolkit and time filters; CSV export
End-to-end check: Run, row on top of Logs, still there after restart

steps.title: Who owns which file
steps.goal: **No file is owned twice.** That is what lets three builders work at the same time.
